name: Bar List
description: Ranked bars for a dimension: value and % of total, Top N + Others, several KPIs with switch buttons (incl. calculated ones), drill-down from Category to Sub-Category (up to 4 levels), optional breakdown and target, thin to thick and square to round bars.

encodings.name: Category
encodings.tooltip: The dimension: one bar per value (e.g. Salary Bucket). Add more (Category, then Sub-Category …) to drill down: + or a double-click opens a bar.

encodings.name: Measures
encodings.tooltip: One or more KPIs (e.g. COUNT(Customers), SUM(Loan Amount)). With several, viewers switch between them with buttons. Calculated KPIs: Format Extension.

encodings.name: Breakdown
encodings.tooltip: Optional. A second dimension that splits every bar into colored segments.

encodings.name: Target
encodings.tooltip: Optional. A target per bar: shown as a marker, and bars can fill up to it.
